extension.name: ASCII Diagram Renderer
extension.description: Renders hand-drawn ASCII/Unicode diagrams (state machine, architecture, flow, coverage map) of what spec/plan/tasks/analyze already say — plain text, no Mermaid renderer needed.
extension.author: MRZHUH

commands.name: speckit.ascii-diagram.render
commands.description: Render a text-based diagram for the current feature's spec/plan/tasks and append it to the document

hooks.prompt: Render a text diagram (state machine / flow) for this spec?
hooks.description: Sketch a state/flow diagram right after specification

hooks.prompt: Render a text diagram (architecture) for this plan?
hooks.description: Sketch an architecture/component diagram right after planning

hooks.prompt: Render a task dependency diagram for this task list?
hooks.description: Sketch a dependency graph right after task breakdown

hooks.prompt: Render a requirement/task coverage diagram for this analysis?
hooks.description: Sketch a coverage/traceability diagram, printed inline (analyze is read-only — no file is written)
